{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2019}}
{{main|2019 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''women's singles''' competition of the [[2019 World Table Tennis Championships]] was held from 23 to 27 April 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Liebherr 2019 World Table Tennis Championships / Schedule |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |website=ITTF |accessdate=22 January 2019}}</ref> [[Ding Ning]] was the defending champion but lost in the semifinals.<ref>{{cite web|title=Entry list|url=https://oes.ittf.com/view/event/entries/e33449f4-4cc0-4383-b6a2-d151aa14e33c/detail|website=ITTF |accessdate=3 April 2019}}</ref>

[[Liu Shiwen]] won the title after defeating [[Chen Meng]] 9–11, 11–7, 11–7, 7–11, 11–0, 11–9.<ref>{{cite web|title=Liu Shiwen wins in Budapest, third time of asking|url=https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/27/liu-shiwen-wins-budapest-third-time-asking/|website=ITTF |accessdate=27 April 2019}}</ref> Later in a sit down interview with CCTV, Liu stated that she expected Chen to take an early lead since she had a technical advantage, but Liu felt she had a psychological advantage due to her two finals experiences and extreme desire to win.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2021-02-22|title=Liu Shiwen Interview With CCTV - Edges and Nets|url=https://edgesandnets.com/2021/02/22/liu-shiwen-interview-with-cctv/|access-date=2021-02-22|website=edgesandnets.com|language=en-US|archive-date=2021-02-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210222234356/https://edgesandnets.com/2021/02/22/liu-shiwen-interview-with-cctv/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
